description_en: Queries the databases at a specified time or the databases in a specified backup set before you restore a database for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 在为MongoDB实例执行单库恢复前，您可以调用本接口查询指定的时间点或备份集内包含的数据库
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-backup-dbs --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --source-db-instance dds-bp22860000 --restore-time 2019-08-22T12:00:00Z --backup-id 56640000 --resource-group-id rg-ax680000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupDBs

parameters.description_en: The page number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: **1**.
parameters.description_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en: The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 30. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 30. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The ID of the source instance.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the source instance
parameters.name: source_db_instance

parameters.description_en:
The point in time to which the instance is restored. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

>

- The time can be a point in time within the previous seven days. The time must be earlier than the current time, but later than the time when the instance was created.

- You must specify one of the RestoreTime and **BackupId** parameters.
parameters.description_zh:
实例所需恢复的时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

> - 本参数可取值为7天内的任意时间，但是须早于当前时间，且晚于实例的创建时间。
> - 本参数和**BackupId**参数两者中必须传入一项。
